source: pip freeze inside the built research container
pinProvenance: Hand-pinned during discovery. Upstream publishes no CPU lock for an ONNX-Runtime-only consumer of this artifact, so there was no upstream lock to adopt verbatim. The plan fixes only that onnxruntime must be CPU and >= 1.16.0.
onnxRoleIsDiscoveryOnly: onnx is used to read opset_import and graph metadata. It performs no inference and is not required by ONNX Runtime.
